from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Introduction: What is a Vector?", [
            "Vectors have both magnitude and direction.",
            "Scalars possess only magnitude, like numbers.",
            "Vectors are represented in a coordinate plane."
        ])
        
        # Coordinates
        origin = self.grid["F1"]
        end_point = self.grid["C4"]
        
        # Create Vector
        vector = Arrow(start=origin, end=end_point, color=WHITE, buff=0)
        label_v = Text("v", color=WHITE, font_size=24).next_to(vector.get_center(), UP)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(vector), Write(label_v))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFD700") # Gold color
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight arrow in red
        self.play(vector.animate.set_color("#FF0000"))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FF0000")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Draw components
        h_line = DashedLine(start=origin, end=np.array([end_point[0], origin[1], 0]), color="#00FF00")
        v_line = DashedLine(start=np.array([end_point[0], origin[1], 0]), end=end_point, color="#00FF00")
        label_x = Text("x", color="#00FF00", font_size=20).next_to(h_line.get_midpoint(), DOWN)
        label_y = Text("y", color="#00FF00", font_size=20).next_to(v_line.get_midpoint(), RIGHT)
        
        self.play(Create(h_line), Create(v_line), Write(label_x), Write(label_y))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FF00")
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Move vector
        new_end = self.grid["B5"]
        self.play(
            vector.animate.put_start_and_end_on(origin, new_end),
            label_v.animate.next_to(new_end, UP),
            h_line.animate.put_start_and_end_on(origin, np.array([new_end[0], origin[1], 0])),
            v_line.animate.put_start_and_end_on(np.array([new_end[0], origin[1], 0]), new_end),
            label_x.animate.next_to(np.array([new_end[0]/2 + origin[0]/2, origin[1], 0]), DOWN),
            label_y.animate.next_to(np.array([new_end[0], (new_end[1]+origin[1])/2, 0]), RIGHT)
        )
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Flash components
        self.play(
            Flash(h_line.get_midpoint(), color="#FFFF00"),
            Flash(v_line.get_midpoint(), color="#FFFF00")
        )
        self.wait(1)
